question.html:
A sample of monatomic ideal gas undergoes a process in which it absorbs of thermal energy and does of work on the surroundings.

a State the first law of thermodynamics. [1]

b Calculate the change in internal energy of the gas. [2]

c Explain whether the temperature of the gas increases, decreases, or remains constant. [1]
